title: Page 59
transc:
Annapolis April 12 , 1864
Rec'd 10.15 A. M. 13th
Geo D. Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Ann Apple is Flood April sarah for
Knox Animal Unity shelter Wilson has been
as signed and Pontiac a quincy of
panama with oysters torch Attica Zebra he
wicked there for duty wedge if I
can send you shelby Rucker now doing
Vinton duty I will send him or
substitute him for Wilson and send the
latter Webster Jersey getting bully sky larking
SH Beckwith


Ft Monroe April 13th 1864
Holloway Gettys station
for Heckman you will leave
at Colona of the force
sent you last night one
thou sand infant Rye to
march at day light tomorrow
morning on Milners town leaving
main body at that point
with pick its out sending
scouting parties up & down
western branch as far as
possible looking for small boats
& to cover a recognizance
of Navy in cutters period
The scouting party will remain
on branch until cutters get
through scouring the branch then
return to and with the
entire force sign Shaffer Kernel
and chief of staff bully
Geo D Sheldon
